name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.37.0: the payment-port guard is removed, because the rule it enforced is wrong. It refused any port that did not match a per-machine-type rule - coil ttyS3, double ttyS1, single ttyS4 - with an acceptNonStandardPort escape hatch. The rule is disproven: 8626020716 and 8626020714 are both DOUBLES, and the first handshakes on ttyS1 while the second handshakes on ttyS4. The Nayax port depends on how each unit was wired at the factory, so nothing in the backend can derive it, and this guard spent three weeks returning 400 on a correct port that was asked for on 2026-09-06. What remains are the checks that do not require knowing the answer: the port must look like a device path, and it must not be the bus the machine already uses, since a second reader on a live bus corrupts weights and payment together. Also adds a payment serial port field to the wiring panel, which is the second half of the request: paymentSerialPort had no UI at all, and the panel it belongs in never reached the backend - saveDisplaySettings writes to localStorage only, so motor serial port and control board address set there were discarded by the next hydrate while the page said Settings saved. The new save wiring button PUTs the three wiring keys to the settings endpoint, which still gates them to ag_admin. Verified end to end on a double: set_payment_port to ttyS4 accepted, settings PUT accepted, and the config block the machine polls serves paymentSerialPort /dev/ttyS4. Cumulative over v6.36.1.
